summary: Wrote tests/02-for-index-html-page-dicteaza-menu/stop-label.js (node script on the repo's Playwright, Chrome via default launch; 60+ checks). Covers: idle markup (ro/en, no aria-label/data-i-aria); API engine stop label, title, aria-label and red .active background; immediate revert on stop while the 'Transcriu…' pill is still up (delayed route); markup fully restored; rapid toggling; language switch mid-recording in both directions (API, live and idea box) including aria-label; unconfigured API and denied mic never showing the stop label; live engine via stubbed SpeechRecognition (manual stop, onend with wantOn true/false, onerror not-allowed and language-not-supported, unsupported engine); idea box (Ctrl+Alt+I) isolation from the toolbar button, revert on closeIdeaModal, reopen; narrow layout at 390/700/701px (font-size 0, ::before ⏹, narrower box, padding kept, restore after stop, idea button keeps full text, EN aria/title at 390).
